title: Deliver Maize to Wrenfinghill Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Maize** delivered to **Wrenfinghill Food Processing Plant** (industry id 3, near tile 76,87).

A likely supplier is **Parnley Market Farm** (industry id 11, near tile 67,66); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **6,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
